answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The ivory of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. The summit holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
